notes: Original Harbor jobs remain unchanged. No experiment was run by this collector.
Oracle episodes count as zero independent model samples. Unstarted/missing/infrastructure-failed attempts remain visible.
Native token totals are reported as recorded; reasoning token counts may be included numerically, but reasoning text is never published.
